_comment: Published gate records carrying a verdict their gate's CURRENT rules would not issue (vibe-ic#510). MAY ONLY SHRINK. Correcting one is the benchmark-agent's commit under NO-MIX — results and plugin fixes never share a commit — so they are recorded here, not silently fixed by the plugin that found them. 2026-07-31 (#562): the dfm_screen_check rule landed and immediately found three edge_llm_accel records carrying a plain PASS alongside VIA_DEFS_NOT_FOUND — the via screen never examined a via. Correcting them is the benchmark-agent's commit under NO-MIX, so they are recorded here rather than edited: a new rule that fails the tree on pre-existing records would be reverted, and the rule is what stops the NEXT one being written.
